title: Publish one coherent FAISS index generation
description: Inject a candidate defect and change compatibility, integrity, shadow, atomic-swap, and rollback controls. An index file is only one member of the search generation.

incidents.label: Embedding model mismatch
incidents.detail: Queries use a new embedding model while the candidate index still contains the previous vector space.

incidents.label: Truncated serialized index
incidents.detail: An incomplete transfer reaches the serving host with a plausible filename but incorrect bytes.

incidents.label: Index and metadata skew
incidents.detail: Vector IDs come from the new snapshot while filtering and result hydration still read the old metadata generation.
